findings.basis: Count is an unlocked snapshot; captured row can disappear after it, Update RowsAffected is unchecked, nil can report successful marker with no captured row. Missing captured rows must fail safely.
findings.acceptance: Deterministic real MySQL concurrent delete/missing-row or zero-row write detector before/after, checked update affected set under transaction/row locking as appropriate; healthy/idempotent and marker-only retry no resend controls.
